entries.speaker: Gun Properties and Ammo Restoration
entries.en: Guns have a higher attack power than melee[n]weapons, but they have a [clr 2]limited amount of[n]ammunition[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Gun Properties and Ammo Restoration
entries.en: However, [clr 2]your ammunition will be restored after[n]the battle[clr 27], so feel free to use it all up.
